question:
Select the most appropriate word of the given word.

ESTEEM
solution:
The correct answer is **Regard.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points __**

__
 
• **Esteem: **means great respect; a good opinion of somebody.(सम्‍मान; किसी के प्रति आदरभाव) .

 
 
• **Example***: Having learned so much from his father***, ***the boy ***regarded ***him with the utmost esteem****.***
 
 
 
• **​​Regard: **A feeling of admiration for somebody/something; respect.(किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए कोमल भावनाएँ; आदर, सम्‍मान).
 
 
• **​Example: ***He soon won the ****regard ****of her colleagues.*
 
 
 
• 
 ​With the above meanings of the given words, we can say that **option 2** is the correct answer.
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
